_note: Eval dataset v2. Labels were written from the question first, then checked against data/sample-reviews.json and data/manual-tags.json. Groups (docs/routing-plan.md, Eval): regression cases are scored as before and compared with evals/baselines/pre-statistics-routing.json; statistics cases check the path and exact, hand-computed numbers; boundary cases check that questions stay on retrieval or fall back honestly. q01, q02 and q26 moved from regression to statistics: they ask what guests complain about or praise most, which the design routes to a ranking. The corpus is 8 fictional reviews, so these numbers are a harness proof, not a quality claim. Re-baseline on real data.
